cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Dad, will you come to my opening? Even for ten minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know anything about sculpture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You survived every school play. I still want you in my corner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come before we open. I'll unpack the biggest piece with you. I want a memory of tonight with you in it too.
